DecodePolylineShape(string, double)

Decodes a Valhalla/Google-style polyline-encoded string into an array of geographic coordinates. This was converted from the Python sample in the valhalla docs: https://valhalla.github.io/valhalla/decoding/#python

public static List<LocationCoordinate2D> DecodePolylineShape(string encoded, double precision = 1E-06)

Parameters

encoded string

The encoded polyline string to decode.

precision double

The scaling factor used when encoding coordinates. Defaults to 1e-6.

Returns

List<LocationCoordinate2D>

An array of LocationCoordinate2D objects representing the decoded path.
